source_text: Sacerdos edit de sacrificio peccati in loco sancto. Qui peccata populi portat, sanctificatur. Christus esca nostra; peccatum nostrum tulit. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Priest eats from sacrifice of-sin in place holy. Who sins of-people carries, is-sanctified. Christ food our; sin our he-bore. Amen.
pass_b_english: The priest eats of the sin offering [[in a holy place >> Bible:Leviticus 6:26]]. Who bears the people’s sins is set apart. Christ is our food; he [[bore our sins >> Bible:1 Peter 2:24]]. Homilia II CLOSEOUT. Amen.
